awaits synergy benefit |url=https://www.icicidirect.com/research/equity/hdfc-life-insurance-company-ltd/5021 |website=Icicidirect.com}}{{cite web |title=Report: HDFC Life Insurance |url=https://bsmedia.business-standard.com/_media/bs/data/market-reports/equity-brokertips/2025-04/17452260570.71620000.pdf |website=bsmedia.business-standard.com}}{{cite web |title=Comparative Analysis of LIC and HDFC Life Insurance: A Study of Market Dynamics, Financial Performance, and Consumer Perception |url=https://www.ijfmr.com/papers/2025/2/39739.pdf |website=Ijfmr.com}} }} '''HDFC Life Insurance Company Limited''', [[doing business as]] '''HDFC Life''',{{cite news|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/hdfc-standard-life-insurance-is-now-hdfc-life-insurance/article26028196.ece|title=HDFC Standard Life Insurance is now HDFC Life Insurance|work=thehindubusinessline|access-date=25 January 2019}} is an Indian [[life insurance]] company, headquartered in [[Mumbai]]. The company offers individual and [[group insurance]] services, and was incorporated in 2000.{{cite news |title=HDFC Life IPO opens today; 9 key things to know about HDFC group's first public offer in 22 years before you subscribe |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/market/hdfc-life-ipo-opens-tomorrow-8-key-things-about-hdfc-groups-1st-public-offer-in-22-years/921286/ |access-date=23 April 2021 |publisher=The Financial Express |date=6 November 2017}}{{cite news |title=HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd. |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/hdfc-life-insur-21997/information/company-history |access-date=23 April 2021 |publisher=Business Standard India}} == History == The [[Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority]] (IRDA) was constituted in 1999 as an autonomous body to regulate and develop the insurance industry. The IRDA opened up the market in August 2000 with the invitation for application for registrations. HDFC Life obtained the certificate of commencement of business on 12 October 2000 and a certificate of registration from [[Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India]] (IRDAI) to undertake the life insurance business on 23 October 2000, becoming the first private sector life insurance company in India.{{cite web|title=History of IRDA|url=http://www.irdaindia.org/hist.htm|publisher=IRDA|access-date=4 December 2013}} The company was a joint venture between Indian housing finance institution [[Housing Development Finance Corporation|HDFC]] and UK-based investment company Standard Life (now [[Abrdn]]). In 2016, Standard Life increased its stake in HDFC Life from 26% to 35%. In the same year, HDFC Life established its first international subsidiary in the UAE called [[HDFC International Life and Re]]. By 2017, it was the country's third-largest private sector life insurance company with a 16.5 percent share of total private-sector premiums for the Financial Year 2017 and fourth largest in the life insurance industry based on premium earned.{{cite news |title=HDFC Standard Life IPO: Here's All You Need To Know |url=https://www.bloombergquint.com/ipos/2017/11/06/hdfc-standard-life-ipo-heres-all-you-need-to-know |access-date=23 April 2021 |publisher=BloombergQuint |date=6 November 2017 |language=en}}{{cite news |last1=Unnikrishnan |first1=C. H. |title=HDFC Life: From Strength To Strength |url=http://www.businessworld.in/article/HDFC-Life-From-Strength-To-Strength/04-01-2019-165791/ |access-date=14 May 2021 |publisher=BW Businessworld |date=4 January 2019 |language=en}} It was the second largest private pension fund management company in India in terms of assets under management and subscribers in 2017.{{cite web|title=HDFC Life launches two pension plans in June|date=5 July 2013 |url=http://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/hdfc-life-launchestwo-pension-plansjune_911496.html|publisher=Money Control|access-date=4 December 2013}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== {{commons category}} *{{official}} {{HDFC Group}} {{Insurance in India}} {{Nifty 200 companies}} {{NIFTY 50 companies}} [[Category:Financial services companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Life insurance companies of India]] [[Category:Financial services companies established in 2000]] [[Category:NIFTY 50]] [[Category:HDFC Group]] [[Category:2000 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 2000]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
